title: oenothera claviformis var. purpurascens
intro: Oenothera claviformis var. purpurascens, commonly known as Purple Evening Primrose, is a perennial plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The Purple Evening Primrose plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Oenothera claviformis var. purpurascens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
